case.title: Report of the President’s Commission on the Assassination of President John F. Kennedy
case.author: President’s Commission on the Assassination of President Kennedy
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF, copied without modification and verified against its byte count and SHA-256. GovInfo identifies this report and links its official PDF from the publisher feature page. PDF metadata credits Internet Archive digitization.
case.rightsBasis: U.S. Government commission report published by GPO in 1964, retained as an external development corpus source. The PDF is not bundled or relicensed under MIT.
coverage: scanned pages with existing OCR text
case.reviewStatus: Full default conversion fails the image-output ceiling; nine-page excerpt spot checks expose text-layer, reflow and column-order defects. Full-book fidelity is unqualified.

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Existing OCR errors survive despite an unverifiedTextLayer review warning; invisible Courier text becomes preformatted prose with hard wraps and spurious headings.
Excerpt notes interleave columns: 415, 477, 416, continuation of 477.
Excerpt index interleaves Federal Bureau of Investigation into De Mohrenschildt and promotes entries to headings.
Object-replacement placeholders are emitted as paragraphs and counted as reflowed text on a textless scan; cover page 1 behaves similarly.
knownFidelityIssues.resolution: Source pages 1 and 920 retain image-only fallback; the pinned nine-page excerpt has seven reflowed pages. See measurements/quality-and-raster-fixes/record.md.

case.baselineStatus: Fails maximumOutputBytes (image output) after the last completed reconstruction page 390/920; no EPUB is published. See measurements/gpo-warren-1964/record.md.

rightsClearance.scope: Commercial use and redistribution of the development corpus; retain applicable license attribution.

case.downloadVerification: A fresh download through tools/fetch_corpus.py matches the owner-supplied identity; see measurements/corpus-downloads/verification.json.

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction

receiptNote: Effective CLI options are supplied by the exec launcher; the preserved raw evaluator receipt assumes library defaults. This derived receipt records the effective options and underlying implementation separately.
